name: phone-input
title: Phone input
description: A phone number the way you'd say it, with its country: one well led by a country key (flag and chevron), the dial code engraved after it, the number grouped as you type with the caret kept by digits. Pasting "+44…", "0044…" or typing "+" moves the country (area codes split +1, +44, +7). The key opens Combobox's plate: search by name, dial code or ISO code, Recent first. The value is E.164 once complete (null before); too short or too long is said on leaving; the readback names the country and "mobile". Sizes, disabled, `only`, and `countries` to add a market's rules.
base: Field, FormField and Base UI Combobox (Combobox's parts)
